$comment: Mission 1.82 §3. The EXACT set of CPV concepts a bounded first-party vocabulary lookup may ask about, derived from held division-92 procurement records before any label was retrieved. It carries no labels, deliberately: the codes were chosen by what the held records classify, and a retrieved label may not add one, remove one, or send the lookup deeper. Membership is read through the production extractor's own `_cpv_prefix` rule at each grain -- the same rule the derivation uses -- so a notice whose codes name two subjects at a grain, or none deep enough, contributes no code at that grain.
DERIVATION_BASIS: sros_nlp.extractors.procurement_value_contrast.ProcurementValueContrastExtractor._cpv_prefix at grain 3 (group) and 4 (class), over every held, non-superseded procurement_notice NormalizedRecord carrying a CPV code in division 92
